title: [YouPass Collect] - Volcano Position and Village Before/After Eruption

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The given pictures illustrate the position of a volcano and the transformation of a nearby village before and after a volcanic eruption.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the village underwent significant changes following the eruption. Most notably, the shift from a dormant to an active state of the volcano resulted in considerable destruction to both the residential buildings and the surrounding natural vegetation.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the first two diagrams, the volcano was positioned on an isolated island entirely surrounded by the ocean. Adjacent to the volcano, a small village was established, comprising multiple houses interspersed with several palm trees scattered throughout the area. These residential buildings and tropical trees occupied a substantial portion of the island, suggesting a relatively dense and thriving settlement prior to the volcanic activity.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Following the eruption, the volcano became active, and molten lava flowed down from the crater through the village before eventually reaching the coastline, where it formed a large pool. As a result, the houses situated directly in the path of the lava flow were completely destroyed, significantly reducing the overall number of dwellings in the area. However, those located away from the lava stream remained intact and appeared entirely unaffected by the disaster. Similarly, a considerable number of palm trees were eliminated by the flowing lava, whereas those in the unaffected areas managed to survive the volcanic eruption.
